title: OFM unmapped (quarantined) value
description: Payload of ofm/_unmapped/{source}/{address}: a value from an address that is not in the model (ADR-0001). Not retained. In the topic, '/', '+' and '#' in the address are replaced by '_'; the original address is in addr.

v.description: Raw value as received; not normalised, because there is no model entry to normalise it with.

addr.description: Original, unaltered source address (e.g. DB20.Press or an OPC UA NodeId).
